en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get some fresh air
Let's go for a run
Let's relax in the sun
Huh? Why would wanna suck air?

Wouldn't a virgin like you rather suck on
these titties than suck air?
Oh, I know!

How 'bout I make you an an air purifier 
that makes the air taste like my musk?
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>That'd be the opposite of
an air purifier.
Huh? I don't wanna run.

Asking an inventor to exercise is like asking
a sumo wrestler to put the chopsticks down!

This is why you'll always be a virgin!
Cuz you don't even know basic shit like this!

Ohhhh...
I know what you're plotting.

You got a thing for tan girls and you wanna
make me more your type, huh virgin!?

Guess I got no choice! I'll get so tan even the
night sky will be like, "Damn, you're dark!"

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
